question: bounding box of each continent
sql: SELECT continent, ST_XMin(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS min_lon, ST_YMin(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS min_lat, ST_XMax(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS max_lon, ST_YMax(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS max_lat FROM countries GROUP BY continent ORDER BY continent;

question: countries crossing box 15 42 20 46
sql: SELECT name, iso_a3, continent FROM countries WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(15, 42, 20, 46)) ORDER BY name;

question: countries fully inside 166 -1.6 168 0.6
sql: SELECT name, iso_a3 FROM countries WHERE ST_Within(geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(166, -1.6, 168, 0.6)) ORDER BY name;

question: airports intersecting envelope -25 63 -13 67
sql: SELECT name, iata_code, type FROM airports WHERE geometry && ST_MakeEnvelope(-25, 63, -13, 67) ORDER BY name;

question: mid airports 25-35N 85-95W
sql: SELECT name, iata_code FROM airports WHERE type = 'mid' AND ST_X(geometry) BETWEEN -95 AND -85 AND ST_Y(geometry) BETWEEN 25 AND 35 ORDER BY name;

question: airports inside bounding box of Oman
sql: WITH om AS (SELECT ST_Extent_Agg(geometry) AS b FROM countries WHERE name = 'Oman') SELECT a.name, a.iata_code, a.type FROM om, airports a WHERE ST_Intersects(a.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(ST_XMin(om.b), ST_YMin(om.b), ST_XMax(om.b), ST_YMax(om.b))) ORDER BY a.name;
